description_en: Changes an agent's status to invisible. This is equivalent to the outbound-only mode
description_zh: 修改隐身状态（等同于仅外呼场景）
kebab_example: aliyun ccc change-visibility --instance-id szpczf --user-id sam@szpczf --invisible true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeVisibility

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connect Center instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set the agent's status to invisible
parameters.help_zh: 是否切换为隐身状态。隐身状态和仅外呼含义一致
parameters.name: invisible
